Rows read on page images (no quotation, the transcription between « and » in the note): Hall (1978) and Hall and Jorgenson (1967), whose scans have no usable text layer; Modigliani and Steindel (1977), whose text layer has no spaces between the words; Table 2 of Kuznets (1942), whose figures the text layer misreads; the headings of Public Law 94-12 that the text layer spaces out (pp. 27, 36, 66); Friedman's equations (2.6) to (3.3), Modigliani's Figures 1 and 2 and equations (1) to (3), Tobin's equation (3) and his definition of ΔK_t below it, which the text layers do not carry; the journal's line at the foot of Blinder's first page; Horioka's Table S-1, an image without a text layer. Misreadings of the text layers and misprints, each as printed in the quotation: 'IL' for 'II' (fr_postwar); 'use' for 'rise' (fr_rise); 'bow' for 'how' (fr_define); 'pro. portion' for 'proportion' (fr_keynes); 'FrancoModigliani' without a space (fr_fn12); '3 l/4' for 3¼ (md_numbers); 'lit' for 'fit' (md_lit); '4 l/3' for 4⅓ (md_three_pct); '[ 19631)' for '[1963])' (md_wealth_series); 'Pagers on Economics Activity' for 'Papers on Economic Activity' (md_ref_steindel); 'ol,served' for 'observed' (hy_accounting). The fractions are read by the rule 'lfrac' of checks/check_ch39.py. Disagreements between the sources: Modigliani's lecture cites 'Modigliani and Steindel [1971]' (md_steindel); its list of references gives the paper of 1977 (md_ref_steindel). Modigliani says the model predicted for the United States, at 3 per cent growth, a wealth-income ratio of 4⅓ and a saving rate of 13 per cent (md_three_pct), without the assumptions; the stripped-down model of the lecture with L = 50, M = 10 (md_delta) gives about 3.69 and 11.1 per cent at 3 per cent (checks/check_ch39.py). Horioka writes that the household saving rate exceeded 15 per cent only from 1961 to 1986 (ho_period); Horioka's Table S-1 has 14.9 in 1963 and 14.1 in 1967 (ho_t1_1963, ho_t1_1967). The note of Table S-1 gives the 2008SNA data the base year 2020 (ho_table_note), the note of Horioka's Figure 1 the base year 2015 (ho_fig_note); ESRI's tables of 2024 are on the 2020 base (esri2024_title). Modigliani and Steindel give the rebate paid out in the second quarter of 1975 as $8 billion, a $32 billion annual rate (ms_paid), and later call the rebate 'nearly $26 billion' (ms_26), without saying how it is counted. Kuznets's day of death: 8 July 1985 in the LoC record (loc_kuznets_died), 9 July 1985 in the GND (gnd_kuznets_died). Single witnesses: Kuznets's averages by decades (ku_t2_1879 to ku_t2_1929); Friedman's estimates of k, of the horizon and of the multiplier (fr_k_groups, fr_horizon, fr_kstar, fr_mult); Hall's regressions and F statistics (ha_table1, ha_table1_log, ha_lags, ha_exclusion, ha_lags4); Hall and Jorgenson's rentals and shares (hj_rental, hj_net, hj_gross); Modigliani and Steindel's Table 6 (ms_table6, ms_fourth); Blinder's estimates (bl_blend, bl_38); the estimates of the rebates of 2001 and 2008 (jps_spent, jps_twothirds, pa_spent). Japan's household saving rate has two witnesses, ESRI's tables (esri_household_saving_1955_2024) and Horioka's Table S-1, which cites them (ho_t1_1955 to ho_t1_2024, ho_table_note); they agree. Indirect testimony: Friedman quoting Keynes (fr_keynes); Modigliani on the essays with Brumberg (md_essays), on Reid (md_reid), on Brady and Friedman (md_brady) and on Ando and Modigliani (1963) (md_wealth_series); Hall and Jorgenson on Jorgenson's earlier work (hj_jorgenson); Tobin on Tobin and Brainard (1968) and Tobin (1969) (to_footnote); Modigliani and Steindel on Tobin and Dolde (ms_tobin_dolde); Johnson, Parker and Souleles on unpublished Treasury estimates of the returns that received the rebate of 2001 (jps_treasury); Kaplan and Zingales on Fazzari, Hubbard and Petersen (1999) (kz_admit, kz_empirical); the journal versions of Johnson, Parker and Souleles (2006) and of Fazzari, Hubbard and Petersen (1988) from the references of Parker et al. and of Kaplan and Zingales (pa_ref_jps, kz_ref_fhp). Not obtained: Modigliani and Brumberg (1954) and (1979); Ando and Modigliani (1963); Jorgenson (1963); Tobin (1969); Brainard and Tobin (1968); Hayashi (1982); Flavin (1981); Hsieh, Shimizutani and Hori (2010); Kaplan and Zingales (1997): only the scan of NBER Working Paper 5267 (September 1995), whose text layer is not readable; Fazzari, Hubbard and Petersen's response of January 1996, NBER Working Paper 5462, likewise; Fazzari, Hubbard and Petersen (1999), which Kaplan and Zingales answer. Life dates: Ford, Friedman, Keynes, Kuznets, Reid, Fisher, Kennedy, Tobin and Hall from the Library of Congress (loc_ford, loc_friedman, loc_keynes, loc_kuznets, loc_reid, loc_fisher, loc_kennedy, loc_tobin, loc_hall); the GND agrees where it has the years (gnd_ford_born, gnd_ford_died, gnd_kuznets_born, gnd_kuznets_died, gnd_reid_born, gnd_reid_died, gnd_tobin_born, gnd_tobin_died, gnd_hall_born). Modigliani: the LoC heading has no years, the record's source note gives the dates of birth and death (loc_modigliani_note), as the GND does (gnd_modigliani_born, gnd_modigliani_died). Jorgenson's year of death and Ando's year of birth from the GND only (gnd_jorgenson_died, gnd_ando_born); the LoC record of Ando has 'd. 2002' in a source note (loc_ando_note), as the GND has (gnd_ando_died). Steindel's year of birth from the LoC record's source note (loc_steindel_born). Brumberg: no record found in the LoC or the GND: '生卒年未详'.
